items.q: What is the formula for Ohm’s law?
items.qAf: Wat is die formule vir Ohm se wet?
items.explain: Voltage equals current times resistance, V = I × R, at constant temperature.
items.explainAf: Spanning is gelyk aan stroom maal weerstand, V = I × R, by konstante temperatuur.

items.q: A resistor has 6 V across it and 2 A flowing through it. What is its resistance?
items.qAf: ŉ Weerstand het 6 V oor en 2 A deur. Wat is sy weerstand?

items.q: If the resistance doubles and the voltage stays the same, what happens to the current?
items.qAf: As die weerstand verdubbel en die spanning bly dieselfde, wat gebeur met die stroom?
items.explain: I = V ÷ R, so doubling R halves the current.
items.explainAf: I = V ÷ R, dus halveer die stroom wanneer R verdubbel.

items.q: Two 1.5 V cells connected in series give a total voltage of:
items.qAf: Twee 1,5 V-selle in reeks gekoppel gee ’n totale spanning van:
items.explainAf: Spannings tel by mekaar bymekaar in reeks: 1,5 + 1,5 = 3 V.

items.q: Two identical resistors are connected in series. What is the total resistance if each is 4 Ω?
items.qAf: Twee identiese weerstande is in reeks gekoppel. Wat is die totale weerstand as elk 4 Ω is?
items.explainAf: In reeks tel weerstande by mekaar bymekaar: 4 + 4 = 8 Ω.

items.q: Two identical 4 Ω resistors are connected in parallel. What is the total resistance?
items.qAf: Twee identiese 4 Ω-weerstande is parallel gekoppel. Wat is die totale weerstand?
items.explain: For two equal resistors in parallel, R = 4 ÷ 2 = 2 Ω.
items.explainAf: Vir twee gelyke weerstande parallel is R = 4 ÷ 2 = 2 Ω.

items.q: The opposition of a component to the flow of current.
items.qAf: Die teenstand van ’n komponent teen die vloei van stroom.

items.q: The energy transferred per unit of charge, measured in volts.
items.qAf: Die energie wat per eenheid lading oorgedra word, gemeet in volt.

items.q: A resistor whose resistance can be changed.
items.qAf: ’n Resistor waarvan die weerstand verander kan word.

items.text: Ohm's law: the current through a conductor is directly proportional to the [[]] across it, if the [[]] stays constant.
items.textAf: Ohm se wet: die stroom deur ’n geleier is direk eweredig aan die [[]] daaroor, as die [[]] konstant bly.

items.text: Adding resistors in [[]] increases the total resistance, while adding resistors in [[]] decreases it.
items.textAf: Om resistors in [[]] by te voeg, verhoog die totale weerstand, terwyl om resistors in [[]] by te voeg, dit verlaag.

items.q: In a series circuit the current is the same everywhere.
items.qAf: In ’n seriestroombaan is die stroom oral dieselfde.
items.explain: True. There is only one path, so the same current passes through each component.
items.explainAf: Waar. Daar is net een pad, dus gaan dieselfde stroom deur elke komponent.

items.q: A thicker wire of the same material has a higher resistance.
items.qAf: ’n Dikker draad van dieselfde materiaal het ’n hoër weerstand.
items.explain: False. A thicker wire has a lower resistance because there is more space for charge to flow.
items.explainAf: Onwaar. ’n Dikker draad het ’n laer weerstand omdat daar meer ruimte is vir lading om te vloei.

items.q: In a parallel circuit, the voltage across each branch is the same.
items.qAf: In ’n parallelle stroombaan is die spanning oor elke tak dieselfde.
items.explain: True. Each branch is connected directly across the cell.
items.explainAf: Waar. Elke tak is direk oor die sel verbind.

items.q: A current of 0,5 A flows through a resistor when the voltage across it is 6 V. Calculate the resistance.
items.qAf: ’n Stroom van 0,5 A vloei deur ’n resistor wanneer die spanning daaroor 6 V is. Bereken die weerstand.

items.q: Resistors of 3 Ω, 5 Ω and 4 Ω are connected in series. What is the total resistance?
items.qAf: Resistors van 3 Ω, 5 Ω en 4 Ω word in serie verbind. Wat is die totale weerstand?
items.explain: In series the resistances add: 3 + 5 + 4 = 12 Ω.
items.explainAf: In serie word die weerstande bymekaargetel: 3 + 5 + 4 = 12 Ω.

items.q: Two 6 Ω resistors are connected in parallel. What is their total resistance?
items.qAf: Twee 6 Ω-resistors word in parallel verbind. Wat is hul totale weerstand?
items.explain: 1/R = 1/6 + 1/6 = 2/6, so R = 3 Ω. (Two equal resistors in parallel give half the resistance of one.)
items.explainAf: 1/R = 1/6 + 1/6 = 2/6, dus R = 3 Ω. (Twee gelyke resistors in parallel gee die helfte van die weerstand van een.)
